paper_record.title: Non-volatile Orbital magnetoelectric effect in a two-dimensional electron gas
paper_record.abstract: Electrical control of orbital magnetism is a central goal of orbitronics. While current-induced orbital polarization has recently been demonstrated in inversion-asymmetric systems, nonvolatile electrical control of an equilibrium orbital moment has remained elusive. Here, using x-ray absorption spectroscopy with \textit{in situ} electric-field control of the FE polarization, we demonstrate non-volatile switching of the equilibrium orbital magnetization of the oxide q2DEGs formed at the LaAlO$_3$/EuTiO$_3$/Ca-STO (001) interface. X-ray linear dichroism reveals a reversible modulation, driven by the FE-polarization direction, of the Ti-3$d$ crystal-field splitting and orbital occupancy, establishing a ferroelectric-like metallic state. X-ray magnetic circular dichroism shows a polarization-controlled switching of the Eu$^{2+}$ orbital magnetic moment induced by the orbital magnetization of the q2DEG projected onto Eu-5$d$ states and detected at the Eu-$M_{4,5}$ edge through Eu-5$d$/Eu-4$f$ hybridization in the inversion-symmetry-broken interface. These results provide spectroscopic evidence of ferroelectric control of orbital magnetism in an oxide q2DEG.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文利用X射线吸收和二色性谱学，在氧化物二维电子气中实现了对平衡轨道磁化强度的非易失性电控转换。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper demonstrates non-volatile electrical switching of the equilibrium orbital magnetization in an oxide two-dimensional electron gas using x-ray absorption and dichroism spectroscopies.

problem.zh: 如何在铁电氧化物二维电子气体系中实现对自旋和轨道自由度的非易失性电学调控，特别是针对平衡态轨道磁化强度的电控开关。
problem.en: How to achieve non-volatile electrical control of spin and orbital degrees of freedom in ferroelectric oxide two-dimensional electron gases, particularly realizing electrical switching of equilibrium orbital magnetization.

approach.zh: 制备LaAlO3/EuTiO3/Ca-SrTiO3异质结构，结合原位背栅极电压控制与X射线吸收光谱、线堡/圆二色性（XLD/XMCD）测量，并辅以多轨道紧束缚与构型相互作用模型分析。
approach.en: Fabrication of LaAlO3/EuTiO3/Ca-SrTiO3 heterostructures, combined with in-situ back-gate voltage control, x-ray absorption and dichroism (XLD/XMCD) measurements, supported by multi-orbital tight-binding and configuration-interaction modeling.

main_takeaway.zh: 铁电极化能够非易失性地调控界面Ti-3d轨道的劈裂与占据，并通过杂化在Eu-4f/5d态中诱导并开关一个显著的轨道磁化强度。
main_takeaway.en: Ferroelectric polarization non-volatilesly modulates Ti-3d orbital splitting and occupancy, inducing and switching a sizeable orbital magnetization in Eu-4f/5d states via interfacial hybridization.

why_it_matters.zh: 该工作证实了氧化物二维电子气可以作为表现出铁电金属特性的多铁性平台，为轨道电子学（orbitronics）中的非易失性器件开辟了新途径。
why_it_matters.en: This work establishes oxide two-dimensional electron gases as multiferroic platforms exhibiting ferroelectric metallic behavior, opening new routes for non-volatile devices in orbitronics.

reason.zh: 首次在实验上通过光谱学证据展示了氧化物二维电子气中轨道磁化强度的非易失性铁电调控，深化了对多铁性界面的理解。
reason.en: It provides the first spectroscopic evidence of non-volatile ferroelectric control of orbital magnetization in an oxide 2DEG, advancing the understanding of multiferroic interfaces.

reason.zh: 该研究结合了前沿的氧化物界面分子束外延/PLD、先进同步辐射X射线谱学以及深度理论建模，具有极高的物理与应用价值。
reason.en: The study combines cutting-edge oxide interface growth, advanced synchrotron x-ray spectroscopy, and deep theoretical modeling, holding exceptionally high physical and application value.
